defs.def: a soft white substance that is made from soya and used in cooking, often instead of meat 豆腐

ex.s: Dandan noodles and mapo tofu are sure bets.
ex.t: 担担面和麻婆豆腐是绝对不会踩雷的选择。

ex.s: But just when I thought I could deal with all Chinese food, I came across stinky tofu, a horrible grey thing that looked and smelt like a burnt sports shoe.
ex.t: 但就在我以为我能对付所有中国食物时，我遇到了臭豆腐，一种可怕的灰色东西，看着闻着都像一只烧焦的运动鞋。

ex.s: Maybe I'll fa in love with stinky tofu-someday.
ex.t: 也许有一天我会爱上臭豆腐。

ex.s: Dad can cook a super "full English breakfast "of bacon, eggs, beans, sausages and toast with butter if Mum and I can find a way to get him into the kitchen!
ex.t: 如果我和妈妈能想办法把爸爸弄进厨房，他就能做一顿超级棒的“全套英式早餐”——熏肉、鸡蛋、豆子、香肠和黄油吐司！

ex.s: I came across stinky tofu，a horrible grey thing that looked and smelt like a burnt sports shoe.
ex.t: 我遇到了臭豆腐，一种看起来和闻起来都像烧焦的运动鞋的可怕的灰色东西。

ex.s: This happens when a plant, say a bean plant, gets attacked by insects.
ex.t: 当一株植物，比如豆类植物，遭到昆虫攻击时就会发生这种情况。
